'''Elyhek Rue''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Elyhek Rue flew with the [[Griffon Flight Wing]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] sent to fight the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], where he took part in numerous raids, attacking the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']],<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> distinguishing himself with a cool head and acrobatic skill in the cockpit. Later transferred to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], Rue was given charge of the squadron's fourth [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] in the hope of keeping the talented but reckless [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Nozzo Naytaan]], [[Red Nine/Legends|Red Nine]], in check.<ref name="TEGW" />

[[File:Red_7_Rue.jpg|thumb|250px|Rue flying as Red Seven]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was present in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the briefing for the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], where he sat next to [[Lepira/Legends|Lepira]] and in front of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. He participated in the ensuing battle under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Red Seven/Legends|Red Seven]], and was killed in action. After his [[Death/Legends|death]], Luke Skywalker successfully destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="TEGW" /><ref name="Episode IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name and initial backstory for Elyhek Rue was established by the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].
